purpose: Preregistered technical-blocker slice for causal arrival-quote evidence on the immutable Five-Tool v3.6 opportunity stream. This plan selects no companion, freezes no economic threshold, authorizes no data read, and creates no performance claim.

candidate.role: possible entry-only veto after a separate reviewed campaign preregistration
candidate.reason: The candidate is orthogonal and directly cost-relevant, but no certified quote history, exact admission clock, content-addressed cost schedule, or incremental out-of-sample evidence exists.

searxng.detail: General engines returned no results because Brave was rate-suspended and DuckDuckGo/Startpage required CAPTCHA; local Google Scholar and Semantic Scholar engines returned the primary-source discovery set.

deepapi.detail: Account availability and balance were confirmed without exposing credentials. Two paid deep-research POST attempts were interrupted before DeepAPI created a request; the free request ledger confirmed no request id, debit, or output. No DeepAPI result influenced this plan.

required_metadata: exchange calendar including early closes and DST
clean, seen, and burned partition map

admission_clock.requirement: Freeze the last instant at which the entry can still be withheld without changing Five-Tool exits, sizing, or host signal identity.

causal_clock.join_policy: Select only a same-symbol quote whose source and receipt timestamps are both at or before the admission timestamp; choose the latest eligible source timestamp without backfill from a later receipt.

measurement_contract.valid_quote: positive bid and ask, ask strictly greater than bid, NORMAL normalized condition, causal source and receipt timestamps, stable source identity

threshold_policy.note: This technical slice measures causal evidence only. Any threshold and monotone neighbors require a successor campaign identity frozen before certified bytes are read.

implementation_scope.capability: validate a blocked plan and align synthetic or future owner-certified arrival quotes to explicit admission points

blocked_before_campaign: Owner supplies and certifies identity-bound intraday NBBO/trades data for GLD, IWM, and QQQ.
Owner declares a clean holdout that does not reuse the consumed QQQ 2022-01-01 through 2024-01-10 window.
A reviewed successor preregistration freezes the exact admission clock, quote-age and spread thresholds, monotone neighbors, power, multiplicity, and cost schedule.
The treatment/control evaluator binds one unchanged Five-Tool opportunity stream and permits the treatment to mask entries only.
TradingView execution parity, campaign-level aligned return evidence for PBO, and owner risk limits remain separate blockers.
